scope: Static and scripted moving depth label capture; no model inference
camera: original low camera, 424x240, original intrinsics/clip, rate 1Hz

acceptance.label_harness: GPU NVIDIA; clean exit; balanced callbacks; full/control bitwise at each timestamp; no finite-mask changes and <=1mm inter-frame depth difference; six actor mappings; isolated and leave-one-out ownership agree; report legacy strict inter-frame bitwise gate separately
acceptance.detector: Report only; no retrospective threshold tuning; any observed false positive/negative prevents acceptance

revision_reason: static04 failed strict inter-frame bitwise equality at 4 pixels with max 1.66893e-6m difference and no finite-mask/ownership changes. Keep original failure; declare numeric <= existing 1mm ownership tolerance before new static05. Same-time full/control must still be bitwise equal; detector unchanged.
scan_preprocessing: Official zero/NaN/Inf ->29.99; remove duplicated 2pi endpoint and cyclically order rays into centered monotonic grid; no interpolation

semantic_fusion.policy: Mutual-nearest positive corroboration only; no learned detection means unknown, not non-person; retain every depth proposal

validation.acceptance: No supported non-person depth clusters in full or no-human controls; report supported/missed visible people separately; no training readiness from one fixture
